from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its case cause (案由)."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title/identifier of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The case cause (案由) as explicitly stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is 刑事 (criminal), 民事 (civil), 行政 (administrative) case")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
